title: GC18R Transactional Groundwater Exchange Service Current-Canonical Independent Qualification & Canonical-Admission Readiness

independent_workflows.meaning_of_success: The verifier workflow itself executed successfully and reproduced the registered blocking cases. Success is not a positive qualification decision.

blockers.title: Unchecked transaction revision overflow
blockers.finding: An origin revision equal to INT64_MAX is accepted. Trial/readiness logic evaluates origin_revision + 1_int64 without a headroom guard. The verifier reproduces an accepted ready candidate with a negative wrapped candidate revision.
blockers.impact: Exact lineage/provenance is not fail-closed. This violates typed transaction provenance and creates undefined admission behavior at the revision boundary.
blockers.required_remediation: Reject or otherwise handle origin_revision == INT64_MAX before any increment. Use checked revision advance everywhere and prove candidate/result revisions never wrap or become negative under O0/O2 runtime/FPE qualification.

blockers.title: Prepared-handle single-use is not self-contained in the production contract
blockers.finding: Public checkpoint/prepared derived values are copyable. Wrapper consumption invalidates only the passed value. A verifier backend that satisfies the deferred callback signatures but does not independently retain a one-shot reservation registry can receive a copied stale prepare token a second time and publish twice. The production callback contract does not explicitly require stale-generation rejection before publication even though owner governance claims prepared_handle_single_use.
blockers.impact: The exact-once property required for transactional composition and absolute coupled mass conservation depends on an unstated backend discipline rather than a closed service contract.
blockers.qualification_boundary: This adversarial reproduction does not show that every intended backend duplicates publication. A backend with an atomic one-shot reservation registry can fail-stop stale replay. The blocker is that this requirement is neither enforced by the wrapper nor normatively closed at the production backend boundary.
blockers.required_remediation: Make one-shot reservation identity a mandatory production contract. Enforce stale/replayed prepare-token rejection before irreversible publication, either in service-owned state or by a precisely documented mandatory backend reservation-generation rule. Add copied-handle commit/abort replay qualification proving fail-closed behavior before publication.
